description: Pinned invocations of the ten root-level ecgfeat evaluation tools (doc 06 'Benchmark harness as a release gate'). Every CLI flag below was read from the tool's argparse at baseline revision 52a339c; none is invented. Placeholders: {repo}=tree under test, {data}={repo}/data, {run_dir}=per-run raw output dir, {records}=resolved record list of the first dataset (one argv item per record), {corpus:<id>}=harness-owned corpus root.

tools.delegated_reason: Owned by the golden snapshot harness (benchmarks/golden/, separate engineer). This evaluator harness does not run or pin it.
tools.gate_role: Primary old-vs-new parity harness over the golden manifest (doc 05 B: Phase 0 onward, every phase).
Detect delineation onset/offset regressions after internal moves and pipeline decomposition (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3; full set before Phase 3 completion).
tools.cadence: Every release; optional on PRs touching delineation (doc 06).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 records in RECORDS. The tool only exposes --n (first N of RECORDS) and reads LUDB from the fixed path <tool dir>/data/lobachevsky-...-1.0.1, so no record flag is passed.

tools.gate_role: Guard QT/QRS/T measurements and boundary behaviour on a non-LUDB database (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).
tools.cadence: Every release; optional on PRs touching delineation/intervals (doc 06).

datasets.name: QTDB
datasets.release: PhysioNet qtdb (version not stated in the local copy; identity = manifest hash)
datasets.subset_rule: All 105 records in RECORDS that have a .q1c annotation (the tool's own discovery rule), passed explicitly via --records.

extraction_config.sparse_adapter: channels in slots II/V2, rest zero; scored slot II

tools.gate_role: Guard CSE-style interval measurement behaviour while modules move (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 LUDB records (numeric order), passed explicitly via --records. The tool reads LUDB from the fixed path <tool dir>/data/lobachevsky-...-1.0.1/data.

tools.gate_role: Compare record-level measurements between the algorithm and the LUDB annotation-derived reference (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).
tools.cadence: Every release when annotation or fiducial code changed; otherwise manual quarterly audit (doc 06).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 LUDB records (numeric order), passed explicitly via --records. Only the machine-readable --batch-reports mode is used; the plotting modes are interactive/visual and not gateable. LUDB is read from the fixed path <tool dir>/data/lobachevsky-...-1.0.1/data.

tools.gate_role: Guard QRS detector / delineation equivalence while detection code moves under _engine (doc 05 B: Phases 1 and 3).
tools.cadence: Manual before any detector-selection/policy change; required for a release containing such a change (doc 06).

datasets.name: LUDB
datasets.subset_rule: All 200 LUDB records x 12 leads, passed explicitly via --records. --restrict-to-annotated-span is ON (LUDB annotates only the middle of each 10 s record; without it PPV measures annotation coverage, not detector precision).

extraction_config.comparators_note: neurokit2/biosppy rows do not depend on ecgfeat; they are environment/corpus sentinels

tools.gate_role: Guard ST localisation/amplitude paths on EDB/LTSTDB (doc 05 B: Phases 1, 3 and 4).
tools.cadence: Every release that changes ST measurement; otherwise manual before a schema release exposing new ST fields (doc 06).

datasets.name: EDB
datasets.release: PhysioNet European ST-T Database (version not stated in the local copy; identity = manifest hash)
datasets.subset_rule: All 90 records in RECORDS; tool defaults of 3 evenly sampled events + 1 control per record.

datasets.name: LTSTDB
datasets.release: PhysioNet Long-Term ST Database (doi:10.13026/C2G01T; version not stated locally)
datasets.subset_rule: All 86 records in RECORDS; .stb event protocol; 3 events + 1 control per record, 12 s windows.

extraction_config.st_amplitude_source: tool default (the tool has no st_amplitude_source flag; doc 05's pinned variants cannot be exercised through this CLI)

tools.gate_role: End-to-end batch serialization/compatibility gate for the legacy export (doc 05 B: Phases 2 and 4).
tools.cadence: Release candidate on the pinned batch corpus; manual for very large full-dataset runs (doc 06).

datasets.name: PTB-XL-derived .pt batch corpus
datasets.release: built by benchmarks.harness.corpora.build_batch_pt_corpus from PTB-XL shard 12000 + ptb-xl-metadata-1.0.1
datasets.subset_rule: The tool's production corpus (all_diseases_pt100 generated/real tensors) is NOT present on this machine. Stand-in: for each PTB-XL diagnostic superclass NORM/MI/STTC/CD/HYP, the first 20 records (ascending ecg_id) of local shard 12000 whose active diagnostic statements map to exactly one superclass; saved as <variant>/<class>/real.pt float32 [20,12,T] at 500 Hz and resample_poly(1,5) 100 Hz.

tools.gate_role: Verify that measurement values remain traceable to frozen agent calls after provenance and record-layer changes (doc 05 B: Phases 2 and 4).
tools.cadence: Every PR on the pinned small corpus; full corpus per release (doc 06). Only the small corpus exists locally.

datasets.name: Frozen ecgagent verdicts + staged PTB-XL records
datasets.release: harness corpus 'smv' (verdicts copied from ecgagent_sample_review_20260908 and ecgagent_complex_review_20260908)
datasets.subset_rule: The two agent verdicts that exist on this machine (01000_hr, 01006_hr). The tool scores LLM agent output; producing new verdicts needs a live LLM run, so the 'full corpus per release' tier is blocked here. features/ is regenerated by the tree under test via 'python -m ecgagent.batch extract' (the producer the agent runs used).

datasets.name: PTB-XL metadata (demographics for extraction)
datasets.release: data/ptb-xl-metadata (differs from ptb-xl-metadata-1.0.1 in ptbxl_database.csv; identity = manifest hash)

tools.gate_role: Guard the interpretation-distribution split and its compatibility adapter (doc 05 B: Phase 5).
tools.cadence: Every ecginterpret release and every core release that changes fields consumed by interpretation (doc 06).

datasets.name: PTB-XL
datasets.subset_rule: Deterministic subset: every record of the local PTB-XL shard 09000 (1000 records, 09000_hr..09999_hr, the tool's own sorted *.hea discovery, no --limit). The full 10-shard local copy (10000 records) is not run per release for runtime.

datasets.name: SNOMED-CT condition names
datasets.subset_rule: Condition-name CSV read by the tool.
